transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic to rewrite part of its leaked artificial intelligence bill after safety backlash, confirmed by The Next Web amid criticism over weak thresholds and preemption.
DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer to cut the cost of running artificial intelligence models for developers, confirmed per Crypto Briefing.
Visa, BILL, and Billtrust start pilot for automating invoice payments with artificial intelligence agents, confirmed by TradingView.
Reported by The Michigan Chronicle: Federal Judge allows NAACP lawsuit against Elon Musk's xAI to move forward.
Elite extends Elite Intelligence to Claude and Microsoft Copilot, bringing trusted financial context into the artificial intelligence experiences law firms already use, reported per 01net.
